title: OpenRTB 2.6 User
description: Information known or derived about the human user of the device; the advertising audience.

buyeruid.description: Buyer-specific ID for the user as mapped by the exchange for the buyer.

keywords.description: Comma separated list of keywords, interests, or intent.

kwarray.description: Array of keywords about the user.

customdata.description: Optional feature to pass bidder data that was set in the exchange's cookie.

geo.description: Location of the user's home base.

consent.description: TCF Consent String data structure when GDPR regulations are in effect.

eids.description: Details for support of multiple third party identity providers.

ext.description: Placeholder for exchange-specific extensions to OpenRTB.

yob.description: DEPRECATED. Year of birth as a 4-digit integer.

gender.description: DEPRECATED. Gender, where M = male, F = female, O = known to be other.
